name: Operator Workflow Design Aggregate Summary Panel
purpose: Summarizes operator workflow design readiness across map, task selection, step detail, and handoff readiness.
accessibility: Expose aggregate status, selected task, selected workflow, handoff target, workflow counts, decision, summary, item details, evidence, blockers, and next workflow as visible text.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate aggregate readiness.
Keep workflow item labels and decisions readable so operators can understand the version-level readiness summary.
